name: Energy-constrained pathfinding with bounded frequency slew

search.objective: Among passing candidates minimize cumulative absolute frequency corrections plus 20 times total absolute actuation changes. Actuation term is a synthetic penalty.

limitations: Selecting candidate based on same fixed scenario creates in-sample optimization; controls do not prove generality.
The oscillatory model presumes direct control over an arm's natural frequency, not an implemented actuator.
Actuation and correction costs are invented computational proxies, not measured energy.
Only 252 discrete schedules sampled; no global optimality guarantee.
All trials share one synthetic model/evidence ancestry; no independent experimental witnesses.
No real strong/weak forces or nuclear fusion modeled.
